'''Lelsk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operative.

She grew up with [[Leira]] as orphans on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] before the latter was killed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. Lelsk worked as a [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] operative with the codename '''Go Silent''' before subsequently joining the Alliance as an [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrator]], and was dedicated to finding data about the Empire.

She was assigned to [[Trivar II]] with [[Jaxon Brand]] to recruit and spy. When Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were shot down, she joined the [[Rescue at Glare Peak|rescue operation]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lelsk is one of the pre-generated characters from the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]]. She was then used as one of the pre-generated characters in [[Fantasy Flight Games]] special promotion, ''[[Rescue at Glare Peak]]''.
